definitions.explanation: The outermost part or boundary of something.

examples.japanese: ⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{端|はし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}って→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please sit at the end of the table.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{端|はし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write your name at the edge of the paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{端|はし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please walk on the edge of the road.

notes:
{端|はし} refers to the outermost edge or end of something.

HOMOPHONES (same pronunciation, different words):
- {端|はし}: edge, end (this word)
- ⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧: bridge
- ⟦{箸|はし}→箸：01026_hashi⟧: chopsticks
These are distinguished by kanji and pitch accent in speech.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [noun]⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{端|はし}: the edge/end of ~
- {端|はし}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{端|はし}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: from one end to the other
- {端|はし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄|よ}る→寄る：02440_yoru⟧: to move to the side/edge

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{端|はし}: edge of the table
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{端|はし}: side of the road
- ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{端|はし}: edge of the paper
- ⟦ベッド→ベッド：04501_beddo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{端|はし}: edge of the bed

RELATED:
- ⟦{端っこ|はしっこ}→端っこ：27570_hashikko⟧: corner, edge (casual)
